method_definition.definition: Source-reported smoothed composite SRM 781 heat-capacity curve assembled from enthalpy-calorimeter Cp derived by differentiating fitted enthalpy functions and averaged pulse-calorimetric Cp, then combined using a weighted cubic spline. The high-temperature enthalpy branch includes three measurements on separate MRC sample E alongside SRM 781 samples A/B; this is curve-level provenance and does not assign any individual tabulated temperature row to sample E. Its enthalpy values measured relative to 298.15 K were shifted to the 273.15 K baseline by adding 593.6 J/mol, derived from provisional smoothing of the low-temperature enthalpy data. Molar table value converted to mass-specific basis using source atomic mass 95.94.

Its enthalpy values measured relative to 298.15 K were shifted to the 273.15 K baseline by adding 593.6 J/mol, derived from provisional smoothing of the low-temperature enthalpy data. Molar table value converted to mass-specific basis using source atomic mass 95.94.

sources.read_status: Publisher article inspected for material, solar-aging conditions, Tables 4–10 thermophysical summaries, LFA method, conductivity calculation and CC BY license. Table values transcribed; no pulse-level reanalysis.
claim_notes: Tables 6–10 give average thermal diffusivity, specific heat and thermal conductivity from 25 to 1000 °C; each group mean is based on two samples. Five flash shots per temperature point were repeatability checks.

Thermal diffusivity measured by LFA/Parker method with improved Cape–Lehman post-analysis. Specific heat was evaluated indirectly against reference samples/literature. Thermal conductivity calculated as α·cp·ρ; density by Archimedes method.
The Table 10 slabs 21/24 group has a reported cycle period span of 6–10 min/cycle; specimen-specific assignment is unresolved.
Specific heat values transcribed locally but not runtime-admitted because the catalog has no specific_heat_capacity quantity contract.
No individual sample values or statistical uncertainty inferred from table means.

provenance.method: Publisher PDF tables 2–10, methods, and rights statement inspected; Table 6–10 values transcribed by group. No raw instrument data reanalysis or independent scientific review.

sources.bundled_content: Attributed aggregate table values, source-defined porous SiC identity and five sample-group states; no article assets or raw instrument data bundled.

claim_notes: Only selected factual values from the article tables are transcribed with attribution; do not infer rights for the companion Zenodo workbook.
Values are source-reported thermal-expansion-corrected LNE laser-flash results; three repeats are on the same specimen, not independent specimens.

No raw thermogram reanalysis or thermal-conductivity derivation is claimed.
